summary: Keyboard polish · clean suggestion surface and reliable dismissal

changes.title: Clean prediction and paste strip
changes.detail: Remove ornamental edge bars, Chrome separator and visible word dividers. Retain stable word positions, native keyboard glass and functional actions.

changes.title: Clipboard dismissal and spacing
changes.detail: Remove the redundant hidden close button, retain long-press and accessible dismiss actions with verification-code receipt blocking, and reserve the full Chrome touch slot without phantom spacing.

changes.title: Password manager session cleanup
changes.detail: Clear stale provider-owned suggestions on editor changes; genuine provider actions and privacy safeguards remain intact.
